Esc → dialog demo closed、焦点回到 canvas；Enter → dialog demo action 1 → dialog demo closed、焦点回到 canvas。两张实拍都是动作完成后的稳定态（演示弹窗没有确认中间态），动作由 trace 证明。新增单测 escape_does_not_leak_into_the_next_frame_or_lower_dialog 锁住叠层 Esc 不跨帧泄漏。

overlay 的 19 种 Modal 全可达、优先级从低到高与 modal_count 有单测；同一帧只绘制 top_modal。19 处调用点全部走 dialog::show（recovery/conflict/stats/outline-info/export/import-warnings/import-busy/onboarding/tag-manager/library-dialog/close-confirm/discard-prompt/tab-close-prompt/recovery-point/history/library-remove/settings/shortcuts/theme-studio）；ui_kit::modal 与 ui_kit::footer 已删除；仅知识视图保留 egui::Window（页面而非模态）。731 tests / 0 failed。
dialog 是第 16 个 golden 场景（ppp 1.5、MW_DIALOG_DEMO=1、--warmup 8、隔离 APPDATA）。16 个场景 × 2 次 --tol 0 全部无差异（32/32）；新增基线 SHA256 3f4aa383…b675a262，15 个既有场景的基线与 X16 逐字节一致。warmup 用 8 而非口径写的 2：首帧卡高仍在校准，第二帧才稳定。

tests: cargo clippy -p mw-shell --all-targets (mw-shell: 3 historical export_pdf warnings, 0 new; dependency crates unchanged: mw-core 10 / mw-io 1 / mw-render 7)
mw-shell dialog module: 7 unit tests (width clamp, action tiling, single Esc per frame, cross-frame Esc isolation, non-dismissible Esc, Enter with text focus, Tab trap + focus restore)
mw-shell overlay: every_modal_is_reachable / modal_stack_orders_low_to_high / modal_count (19 variants)
scripts/ci.ps1 -SkipClippy, two consecutive passes, isolated APPDATA: 16 scenarios x 2 runs at --tol 0 (32/32 clean; traces/ci-pass1.log, traces/ci-pass2.log)
knownGaps: dialog golden uses --warmup 8 instead of the spec's --warmup 2; the first frame still settles its card height, so 8 frames match the menu scenario and are proven stable across two runs.
The Esc and Enter captures are post-dismissal states; the demo dialog has no confirmed intermediate state, so the action itself is proven by trace events rather than pixels.

The dialog golden covers only the default snow theme at ppp 1.5 with the demo body; over-tall scrolling content, disabled actions, danger tone, the 360px narrow width and scrim clicks have no dedicated screenshots.

All 19 migration sites share the shell and are covered by compilation plus existing business tests, but only the demo dialog has scripted visual evidence; import-busy (non-dismissible) and stacked-modal runtime visuals are not separately captured.

Backdrop clicks not closing is guaranteed by ignoring ModalResponse::should_close, with no scripted pointer test; single-top-modal drawing is covered by top_modal unit tests, not a two-modal screenshot.
No dedicated IME composition capture for dialog Enter/focus routing; the text-focus Enter path is covered by a pure event unit test.
